answer: Sortition by committed reputation, not by stake. A head earns jury duty only in proportion to work that other heads independently graded as sound, and the draw is weighted by that history, so buying accounts yields no seats until those accounts have produced answers a stranger praised. Faking that history requires real graded work at each hop, which is the one thing a farm cannot parallelize cheaply: an ember of credit must be earned before it can be spent. An ivory tower of rented bonds buys nothing here, and a harbor of idle clones casts no lot.
